article.title: Rapid Characterization of the July 2019 Ridgecrest, California, Earthquake Sequence From Raw Seismic Data Using Machine-Learning Phase Picker
article.scientific_question: Can raw continuous waveforms and a machine-learning phase picker rapidly recover and locate the dense July 2019 Ridgecrest sequence without using the routine event catalog as an event prior?
article.sequence: 2019 Mw 6.4 foreshock, Mw 7.1 mainshock and first six days of aftershocks (2019-07-04 through 2019-07-09 UTC).
article.catalog_relationship: Constructs a PhaseNet–REAL–VELEST–hypoDD catalog and publishes the final 15,445-event Table S1; REAL and VELEST populations are intermediate and are not released locally as separate tables.

evidence.note: Identity, sequence scope and catalog-construction purpose.

catalog.name: Liu et al. Ridgecrest PhaseNet–REAL–VELEST–hypoDD catalog
catalog.scientific_purpose: Independent raw-waveform event detection, association, absolute/relative location and local-magnitude characterization for the early Ridgecrest sequence.
catalog.event_definition: Events with PhaseNet P/S picks that pass REAL association, VELEST quality criteria and hypoDD differential-time filtering; the final Table S1 contains the 15,445 hypoDD solutions.

populations.label: REAL associated events
populations.selection_rule: At least five P picks and 13 total P+S picks in the REAL grid search; stations within 100 km.
populations.spatial_depth_scope: REAL horizontal search region 0.4 degrees with 0.02-degree grid; depth 0–20 km in 2-km steps.

evidence.note: Article reports 16,563 associated events and 195,869 P plus 204,349 S arrivals.
REAL is not a separate local file.

populations.label: VELEST relocated/quality-controlled population
populations.selection_rule: VELEST update from 1,633 events with at least 30 picks of probability greater than 0.8; retain station gap below 200 degrees and RMS below 0.6 s.
populations.spatial_depth_scope: Coso regional 1-D velocity model; absolute locations before hypoDD.

evidence.note: Article reports 16,112 events after VELEST quality filtering; table is not locally released.

populations.label: Final hypoDD event catalog (Table S1)

populations.spatial_depth_scope: Full local range: latitude 35.330306–36.271517 degrees N, longitude −117.979354–−117.234489 degrees, depth 0.001–14.126 km.
populations.magnitude_scope: Local magnitude M −0.20–5.50; two negative-M rows.

construction_workflow.summary: Continuous IRIS/SCEDC waveforms are picked by PhaseNet, associated and initially located by REAL, refined with VELEST, relatively relocated with hypoDD, and assigned local magnitudes before Table S1 export.

input_data.name: Continuous seismic waveforms
input_data.temporal_spatial_scope: 2019-07-04 through 2019-07-09; stations within 120 km of Mw 7.1
input_data.channels_sampling: Vertical or 3-component; fixed channel/sample rate not stated
input_data.availability_conditions: 41 permanent plus 4 temporary stations; changing availability

evidence.note: Station geometry and missing fixed channel/sample-rate detail.

input_data.name: PhaseNet probability picks
input_data.availability_conditions: P/S probability threshold 0.5 for association; above 0.7 for hypoDD weighting/selection

stages.name: Machine-learning phase picking
stages.purpose: Generate P/S candidate arrivals from raw waveforms.
stages.method: Apply PhaseNet to vertical or 3C streams with probability threshold 0.5.
stages.dependencies: Requires waveform availability and model inference.

stages.name: REAL association and grid-search location
stages.purpose: Associate picks and estimate initial origins.
stages.method: Grid search over 0.4-degree horizontal region and 0–20 km depth; stations below 100 km.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Require at least five P and 13 total P+S picks.

evidence.note: Search grid, pick thresholds and intermediate counts.

stages.name: VELEST absolute relocation and station correction
stages.purpose: Update velocity/station terms and reject poor solutions.
stages.method: Use 1,633 high-quality events to update model and station corrections; relocate full REAL population.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Retain station gap below 200 degrees and RMS below 0.6 s.
stages.dependencies: Depends on REAL origins and velocity model.

stages.name: hypoDD relative relocation
stages.purpose: Improve relative event geometry using differential travel times.
stages.method: Use stations below 80 km, picks near P/S trends and high-probability picks; apply SI residual filters.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Remove P outliers above 0.8 s and S outliers above 1.2 s.
stages.dependencies: Depends on VELEST locations and selected picks.

stages.name: Magnitude estimation and export
stages.purpose: Estimate local magnitudes and write Table S1.
stages.method: Deconvolve horizontal amplitudes, apply Wood–Anderson response and Hutton–Boore attenuation.

parameters.name: magnitude_scale
parameters.note: Local magnitude; station selection documented in SI.

stages.dependencies: Requires waveform amplitudes and hypoDD origins.

construction_workflow.final_output: 15,445-row Table S1 final hypoDD event catalog; the local frozen benchmark mask contains 6,242 rows under the shared Ridgecrest rule.

evidence.note: Local final output and benchmark count.

related_products.catalog_relation: Comparison baseline only; article counts conflict (7,425 versus 7,743).

scientific_findings.statement: The raw-waveform workflow recovers a denser sequence than the routine catalog while missing some routine events under strict pick and geometry filters.
Relative relocation improves geometry but the magnitude scale differs from SCSN, especially above ML 4.

benchmark_context.quality_interpretation: Q2 independent automatic research catalog; metric-specific Q1-like relative geometry for well-supported hypoDD events, but no event-level uncertainty.
benchmark_context.recommended_role: Independent-method secondary for detection, association, end-to-end location and magnitude-bias checks.
benchmark_context.comparison_or_baseline_sources: Compare with Shelly Data S1, Ross QTM and operational SCSN only after applying the common time/space/depth mask and harmonizing magnitude definitions.
benchmark_context.valid_comparisons: Event-time recovery, relative fault geometry, association support and method-level omissions.
benchmark_context.caveats: Do not claim universal completeness or direct ML/Mw ranking; shared waveform lineage remains a dependence.

evidence.locator: Quality and comparison notes; Frozen benchmark-window audit
